title: BenchmarkSuite
description: Declarative benchmark suite spec for ao-bench (design doc §5.1). Instructions/fixtures are referenced by PATH, relative to this file; never inlined.

id.description: Lowercase kebab suite id, unique among committed suites.

domain.description: Free-string domain label (e.g. "software"); enables non-dev suites later without a schema change.

tier.description: Benchmark tier; drives per-tier budget/parallel/timeout defaults from benchmarks/tiers.json. Closed list enforced by the loader (bench/spec.py KNOWN_TIERS).

id.description: Lowercase kebab task id, unique within the suite.

instruction.description: PATH to a .md instruction file, relative to this suite.json. Never inline contents.

fixture.description: PATH to a tiny fixture repo dir, relative to this suite.json. Never inline contents.

type.description: Grader type key into GRADER_REGISTRY (e.g. "pytest", "command", "file_assertion", "fake"). Closed list enforced by the loader (bench/spec.py KNOWN_GRADER_TYPES), not this schema, so new types can be added ahead of registry wiring without a schema edit.

command.description: Command to run for pytest/command graders. Defaults are grader-type specific.

cwd.description: Working dir for the grader command, relative to the task's mutated repo.

pass_threshold.description: Minimum score (pass-rate) required to mark solved=true. Defaults to exit-code-only semantics when unset.

assertions.description: file_assertion grader: checks evaluated against the mutated repo.

path.description: PATH relative to the task's mutated repo, checked by this assertion.

substring.description: Required for type=contains: substring that must appear in `path`.

golden.description: Required for type=equals_file: PATH to a golden reference file, relative to this suite.json.
